name: Tang2018 original-task replication and native Cadence comparison
final_goal: A patch-net equilibrium brain that is more scalable, more capable and more efficient than a transformer. Every Cadence result is measured against that goal at matched information, matched task and a declared resource model. The Amen jungle composer is the first test platform.
principles: The main hypothesis stays: a brain that settles in global equilibria. The building block stays as simple as possible, like in nature, and every part of the brain answers with a settled state of that same patch rule; a feed-forward readout or a copied input is a baseline, never a result. Natural evolution is preferred to design: any parameter that looks designed is a gene, picked by selection against the hand-set value, which stays as the control. Within a life only the patch rule learns; across lives the genome evolves.
execution_status: design_only_after_verified_data_import; no baseline or Cadence training run
claim_boundary: Original computational categorization task, not a replication of human behavior or invasive physiology.
Native Cadence settling is a different dynamical law from the original Hopfield network; success would replicate a task effect, not its mechanism.
Cadence result must come from a freshly qualified whole graph. External SVM and published feature outputs are comparison baselines only.
No solver iteration is equated with biological milliseconds. No claim of self-reflection follows from recurrence or lower numerical energy alone.

data.row_alignment: Use original 1-based pres IDs, truth labels, and original row indices; never split partial variants of one object across folds.
data.visibility_percent: 100-black; use original definition and frozen original plotting bins after recovering plotting source; no rounding into convenient new bins.
data.whole_test_rows: Whole325 are separate; partial13000 file contains no fully visible rows.
data.license: No explicit top-level code or dataset license found in inspected author repository trees. Private experimental cache only; this protocol redistributes no image/feature assets.
data.bulk_custody: All original feature/image arrays and any derived arrays over100MB remain on AWS. Local evidence is compact scripts, manifests, and logs.
data.feature_identity: Use the provided caffenet-fc7.mat arrays without silently replacing them with modern torchvision AlexNet features; any fresh extractor needs feature parity verification.
data.distinct_image_claim: 13000 is the number of behavioral/feature rows, not a verified number of distinct images. Bubble variants, repeated conditions and fully blank stimuli may coincide. Preserve row IDs and group by object; report exact stimulus/feature duplicates before model evaluation rather than assume independence.

required_fidelity_gates.requirement: Recover exact outer five object-fold assignments from original saved results or MATLAB rng(1,twister)/crossval execution; save explicit IDs. Source does not explicitly stratify although supplement describes balanced categories. Preserve source-faithful and balanced variants separately if they differ.

Use original saved Hopfield features/weights or verify a port of the MATLAB R2016a newhop construction against reference trajectories; simple outer-product Hebbian weights alone are insufficient evidence of equivalence.

Reproduce default linear LIBSVM C-SVC including actual multiclass behavior, C grid10^-4 through10^4, inner5-fold validation and tie handling. A code comment says one-vs-all; actual LIBSVM implementation determines the behavior.

Resolve supplement fixed-mask-input description versus runMaskedHopFeatures.m additive feature-injection implementation. Reproduce exact mask images/features/timesteps before making a masking replication claim.

Recover exact visibility-bin boundaries and human/model aggregation from original plotting/statistics code before original-figure comparison. Keep modern object-cluster confidence intervals separately labeled.

The proposed public ordinary control has n*n+6*n additional parameters (<0.5% at these widths), and more patches. Report paired capacity/work curves. An exact-capacity promotion claim requires another publicly constructible control; this pair alone cannot establish a unique residual-reading mechanism.

familiar_whole_memory.original_reference: Authors computeHopTimeFeatures trains attractor memory on all325 whole patterns before grouped classifier CV. Only category labels for the260 classifier-training objects are supplied to its readout.
familiar_whole_memory.cadence_adapter: Optional native comparison may pretrain only feature reconstruction on all325 whole patterns, then train category witnesses only on the260 training IDs. Record clean pattern exposure explicitly.
familiar_whole_memory.interpretation: Held-out classifier labels, previously stored clean visual patterns; not unseen-object generalization.

strict_unseen_objects.original_reference: Rebuild all fitted transforms and attractor memory using only260 outer-training objects; do not reuse author all325 Hopfield cache.
strict_unseen_objects.cadence_adapter: Only260 outer-training whole features enter normalization, reconstruction or category learning. Inner-validation objects are excluded from the corresponding inner training.
strict_unseen_objects.interpretation: Stricter distinct experiment; do not compare its result against the all325-memory reference as if information matched.

original_baseline_stage.training: Whole images only; fixed pretrained visual representation. No partial-image augmentation or partial-to-whole training.
original_baseline_stage.evaluation: All13000 partial rows, each assigned exactly once by held-out object ID; report all rows and mask/visibility/SOA/subject slices separately. Whole325 evaluated separately.
original_baseline_stage.reference_dynamics: Bipolarize features by positive=>+1, otherwise-1. Initialize state with partial features; run original newhop/satlins recurrence. Preserve original biases, update convention and sign-stability criterion.
original_baseline_stage.prerequisite: Resolve original_folds and original_newhop before claiming numerical reproduction. Published t256 features may validate static endpoint baseline; they cannot validate recurrence-time curves.

native_cadence_stage.interface: One image record exposes frozen visual features. Body supplies actual measured visual coordinates; category answer is free at query time. Evaluators remain in the task harness; no new library evaluator ports.
native_cadence_stage.representation: All4096 original fc7 features, no PCA, truncation or t-SNE. Per coordinate divide by max(1, maximum authorized whole-training value), then clip to[0,1] for native reconstruction boundary; record test clipping fraction and affected rows without retuning the transform. All native arms share the same transform. Original SVM retains original preprocessing.
native_cadence_stage.normalization_fit: Fit per outer information regime, never partial test arrays; inner validation uses inner-training normalization.
native_cadence_stage.fixed_baseline: Flat5 class patches reading4096 inputs,20485 parameters, measured as a lower-capacity floor only.

acquisition.device: Selected in a bounded timing smoke before training; both comparison arms share same hardware/backend and thread count.
acquisition.tolerance: Pinned unchanged candidate default, exact numeric value exported into execution protocol before first admission.
acquisition.selection: Choose smallest paired width/prior satisfying both acquisition gates across all declared seeds, on whole-only validation. Any larger/different genome requires a new preregistration before partial evaluation.
acquisition.failure_interpretation: Insufficient whole-task acquisition or resource exhaustion; do not interpret as a negative recurrence capability result.

test_conditions.state_reset: Same independent initial continuation per image, shared across pair; no previous test image memory. Pure query must preserve checkpoint.

resource_model.first_pilot: One fold, seed2, width16, paired ordinary/readback, at most12 admissions or600seconds per arm; timing/acquisition feasibility only, not capability.
resource_model.full_execution_gate: Freeze measured hardware, counts, exact tolerance, source hashes, fold IDs and per-arm hard time cap after timing smoke; require new reviewed execution receipt before full training.
resource_model.training_budget_matching: Same ordered records and maximum admissions; the ordinary arm has a disclosed small parameter excess. Separately report accepted admissions, examples, work and wall time; capped/incomplete arms are never treated as equally trained.
resource_model.same_work_comparison: Report accuracy versus real edge/gradient/tensor/reference work and wall time, in addition to disclosed parameter counts. A refusal contributes an incorrect/abstained result, not an omitted row.
resource_model.routine_cost: Compare whole-image cost with increasingly occluded-image cost. Extra compute counts as useful only if it improves task outcomes.

category_encoding.query_decision: argmax of the five free qualified Y states; stable lowest-index tie break

populations.B: n latent patches read4096 raw inputs only
populations.R: 4096 reconstruction patches each read all n latent states
populations.C_observer: n context patches receive inputs=B and observes=R, hence B.states,R.states,R.errors
populations.C_ordinary: 2n context patches receive inputs=(B,R), hence B.states,R.states
populations.Y: 5 category patches each read all B and C states

near_matched_pair_genome.query_witnesses: R coordinates clamp to currently observed sensory features; Y remains entirely free. All B,C,Y state derivatives and all transitive error derivatives are freshly qualified.
near_matched_pair_genome.training_witnesses: Whole visual record supplies R coordinates. Only authorized training object category supplies Y witnesses. Familiar-memory pretraining omits category witnesses for all objects.
near_matched_pair_genome.initialization: Use identical shared B/R coefficients and biases. C width and incoming count differ; report native fan-in normalization and actual draws rather than pretending all context/head slots have exact correspondence.
near_matched_pair_genome.scope: Near-matched parameter comparison with ordinary slightly larger; not exact parameter/patch matching, equal expressive capacity or sole-contact causal isolation. Every ordinary contact carries an existing distinct population coordinate; no duplicate raw/clamped-state input capacity padding.
near_matched_pair_genome.feedback: Ordinary and observer energy derivatives already return influence through the acyclic graph to B. No independently learned reverse state edge is introduced.

ablations.requirement: Flat5 floor is explicitly lower-capacity, not the matched causal control.

Construct a modified graph omitting the C branch and routing Y from B alone, then train/evaluate and freshly qualify that whole graph. This is a lower-capacity control, not a matched causal ablation. Never reuse the intact observer certificate.

Deferred: coordinate-level residual-source permutation is not a public Cortex operation. Do not mutate a private graph or claim a public-API ablation. A future publicly constructible equivalent must be specified before execution.
Train a separate model from a fixed subset of whole patterns with unchanged held-out query rows; report this as lower-information evidence rather than matched primary comparison.

metrics.primary: Top1 category accuracy and macro class accuracy, whole and partial separately; chance20%.
metrics.paired_contrast: Readback-minus-ordinary accuracy on same rows, by visibility and information regime; object-cluster bootstrap95% interval,10000 resamples,seed20261001; report all five seeds separately and pooled hierarchical estimate.
metrics.predeclared_meaningful_effect: At least+0.05 absolute macro accuracy below20% visibility, paired interval lower bound>0, without>0.02 loss on whole objects; also disclose complete visibility curve rather than selecting best bin.
metrics.efficiency_claim: A task-accuracy gain alone is insufficient: report work/latency frontier and whole-image routine-cost change. No efficiency pass if gained accuracy simply follows unconstrained extra work.
secondary: visibility bins from frozen original code
original model-to-human object-difficulty correlations where preprocessing is recovered
ordinary versus observer parameter/patch counts and paired capacity/work curves

adversarial_checks: Mutating held-out labels or future scoring data cannot change any query arguments, states or predictions.
All partial variants of one object share its outer fold; no partial row enters any fitting or selection.
Changing the order of independently reset test images does not change their answers.
Independent original pres/category text exports match decoded MCOS fields and whole labels for every row.
Original fc7 and bipolar t0 baselines both reported, isolating thresholding from recurrence.
Only publicly constructible ablations may run; every modified graph has its own recorded topology and fresh all-coordinate qualification. Coordinate permutation remains deferred.
Changing max budget cannot turn a refusal into a counted qualified answer without a valid fresh certificate.
Training and query wrappers preserve sources, admission atomicity and pure-query continuation.

masking_later_stage.human_task_reference: Image presentation25/50/75/100/150ms followed by500ms phase-scrambled noise or gray screen. Gaussian-bubble visibility and temporal backward masking are separate manipulations.
masking_later_stage.native_requirement: First establish static original-task effect. For timed mask intervention define actual input substitution/injection and a physical/algorithmic clock; do not label early unqualified solver iterates as settled Cadence answers.
masking_later_stage.time_mapping_warning: Authors plotted0=>25ms and256=>150ms with interpolation; this is not a measured conversion from Cadence sweeps to neural time.
masking_later_stage.release_role: No biological or masking replication claim until this separate stage passes.

revisions.reason: Prior candidate B<-C<-B state cycle is unsupported by the public builder. Also public observes adds BOTH state and error contacts, so prior residual-only contact counts were invalid. Replaced with a public acyclic graph and a slightly larger ordinary control; no original-data or run results changed.
